             Admission to Post Graduate (PG) Programmes for the Academic Session 2026–27
                       Notification by the DHE, Govt. of Assam vide Memo No: 682791/5 dtd. 26th July, 2026
        In pursuance of the above-mentioned notification issued by the Directorate of Higher Education, Assam, it is hereby
notified for the information of all eligible candidates that admission to the Post Graduate (PG) Programmes of Mangaldai College
(Autonomous) for the Academic Session 2026–27 will be conducted through the Assam State Higher Education Admission
Portal (SAMARTH) as per the following schedule:

Common PG Admission Schedule
                   Activity                                         Date(s)
                   Registration & Online Application                24th – 30th July, 2026
                   Correction Window                                31st July, 2026
                   Scrutiny of Applications                         1st – 4th August, 2026
                   Preparation & Locking of 1st Merit List          5th August, 2026 (Till 12:30 P.M.)
                   Publication of 1st Merit List                    5th August, 2026 (By 5:00 P.M.)
                   Admission of 1st Merit List                      6th & 7th August, 2026
                   Preparation & Locking of 2nd Merit List          8th August, 2026 (Till 12:30 P.M.)
                   Publication of 2nd Merit List                    8th August, 2026 (By 5:00 P.M.)
                   Admission of 2nd Merit List                      10th & 11th August, 2026
                   Spot Admission                                   12th – 14th August, 2026

                         Sl. No. Programme                                        Intake Capacity
                         1        M.A. in Assamese                                50

                         10       M.Sc. in Zoology                                25

                         12       M.Sc. in Chemistry                              25

Important Instructions
     1. Admissions shall be conducted only through the Assam State Higher Education Admission Portal (SAMARTH).
     2. Original documents must be produced at the time of admission for verification.
     3. The admission schedule is subject to any modification or further notification issued by the Directorate of Higher
         Education, Assam.
Admission Portal: https://assamadmission.samarth.ac.in/pg/index.php
N.B.: Candidates are advised to visit the College website regularly for merit lists, admission instructions, admission procedure
fee details and other updates.
